name: Chitrak
description: Chitrak, also known as Ceylon Leadwort or Doctorbush, is a powerful Ayurvedic herb valued for its ability to improve digestion, reduce inflammation, and detoxify the body. It is great for boosting metabolism, enhancing skin health, and easing joint pain.
benefits: Calms The Nervous System And Reduces Anxiety

Beneficial In Hemorrhoids Of Vata Origin
Prevents Deposits In Arteries, Supporting Heart Health
Treats Skin Conditions Like Acne And Dermatitis
Speeds Up Wound Healing And Promotes New Skin Growth

name: Bhringraj
description: Known as the 'King of Hair', Bhringraj is a legendary Ayurvedic herb that promotes hair growth, prevents premature graying, and strengthens hair from root to tip.
benefits: Calms the mind and reduces stress
geographicalLocations: Found throughout India, especially in moist areas and near water bodies.

name: Triphala
description: Triphala is a traditional Ayurvedic formulation consisting of three fruits - Amalaki, Bibhitaki, and Haritaki. It is one of the most versatile and commonly used herbal remedies in Ayurveda.
geographicalLocations: The three fruits are found across India and Southeast Asia.

name: Neem
description: Neem is a powerful herb known for its antibacterial, antifungal, and blood-purifying properties. Every part of the neem tree has medicinal value.
geographicalLocations: Native to the Indian subcontinent, now grown in tropical regions worldwide.

name: Ashwagandha
description: Ashwagandha is one of the most powerful adaptogenic herbs in Ayurveda. It helps the body manage stress and promotes overall vitality and longevity.
geographicalLocations: Grows in India, Middle East, and parts of Africa.

name: Tulsi
description: Tulsi, or Holy Basil, is considered a sacred plant in India. It is revered for its powerful healing properties and is often called 'The Queen of Herbs'.
geographicalLocations: Native to India, now cultivated worldwide.

name: Shatavari
description: Shatavari is known as the 'Queen of Herbs' for women's health. It is a powerful rejuvenating tonic that supports hormonal balance and reproductive health.
geographicalLocations: Found throughout India, Sri Lanka, and the Himalayas.

name: Brahmi
description: Brahmi is a legendary brain tonic in Ayurveda. It enhances memory, concentration, and overall cognitive function while promoting calmness and mental clarity.
geographicalLocations: Grows in wetlands across India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Vietnam.
